chunks: If God is there to help you none will overcome you; and if He forsake you, who will help you other than Him? So only in God should the faithful place their trust.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for divine victory and reliance on God in Islam?
ai.summary: This verse, revealed in the context of the Battle of Badr, establishes the theological principle that ultimate victory (nasr) and abandonment (khuzl) are solely determined by Allah's will, reinforcing the concept of tawakkul. Shia scholarship often highlights the interplay between human effort (asbab) and divine decree, noting that while believers must strive, their success remains contingent upon God's support. It serves as a reminder that reliance on God does not negate action but rather anchors the outcome in divine wisdom.
